request.input:
Bill number: HB1974
<bill_text>
HOUSE BILL 1974

 By White

 AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 36
 and Title 49, relative to safety.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE:

 SECTION 1. Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 49, Chapter 6, Part 3, is amended by

adding the following as a new section:

 (a) If an order of protection is issued pursuant to title 36, chapter 3, part 6, to

 protect a student who is enrolled in a public school in this state from another student

 who is enrolled in the same public school, then the principal of the school in which both

 students are enrolled shall remove the student who is named as the respondent in the

 order of protection from any classroom or school-sponsored event or activity shared with

 the student who is named as the petitioner in the order of protection.

 (b) The school or school district shall provide the student who is named as the

 respondent in the order of protection with alternative instruction for any class or course

 from which the student is removed for purposes of this section. This section only

 requires a student's removal from a classroom or school-sponsored event or activity for

 the period of time for which an order of protection is in effect.

 SECTION 2. This act takes effect upon becoming a law, the public welfare requiring it,

and applies to orders of protection entered on or after such date.
</bill_text>

<summary>
This bill would require a public school principal to remove a student from any classroom or school-sponsored event or activity if an order of protection has been issued to protect another student in the same school. The school or school district would be required to provide the removed student with alternative instruction for any classes they miss. This requirement would apply only for the duration of the order of protection. The bill would take effect upon becoming law and would apply to orders of protection entered on or after that date.
</summary>

assessments.summary_quote: This bill would require a public school principal to remove a student from any classroom or school-sponsored event or activity if an order of protection has been issued to protect another student in the same school.
assessments.rationale: Conveys the principal's removal duty and same-school condition, but does not specify that removal is limited to settings shared with the protected student or explicitly identify the removed student as the order's respondent.

assessments.summary_quote: The school or school district would be required to provide the removed student with alternative instruction for any classes they miss.
assessments.rationale: Conveys the responsible entities and the duty to provide alternative instruction for classes missed because of removal.

assessments.summary_quote: This requirement would apply only for the duration of the order of protection.
assessments.rationale: In context, conveys that the required separation lasts only while the protection order is in effect.

assessments.summary_quote: The bill would take effect upon becoming law and would apply to orders of protection entered on or after that date.
assessments.rationale: Conveys both the effective date and the limitation to orders entered on or after that date.
